comingLast.roast: at 0.7 per hole he earned every inch of this spotlight
sitting 4 above Jones and driving very, very carefully
in on 5 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
6 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
7 points clear from the bar - watching Jones like a hawk with a beer
8 above the cellar door with 2 to play - just keep scoring
8 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
10 points clear from the bar - watching Jones like a hawk with a beer
his round is over, his sweating is not - 11 above the line
done and 12 above the drop - his interest in Jones's round is intense and personal
